correctness.rationale: The all-parameter formulas are proved by cardinality/root-branch upper bounds and explicit midpoint-splitting binary trees. On cycles the no-wrap step requires block size at most both k and n-k, which is exactly assumed. The static results use an interval-convexity obstruction and sharp pair support configurations. An independently recursive exact enumerator matches every claimed value for all 255 path/cycle parameter cases through order sixteen, with checked leaf witnesses.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General VC bounds for intervals give a ceiling two, and generic finite-class counting gives a logarithmic Littlestone ceiling. Neither proves the matching all-parameter lower bounds, complementary-width cycle cutoff, or the path VC-one phase. Guingona’s complete linear-combination hypothesis is not known for these classes and its equal-dimension conclusion is incompatible with their large strict gap.

value.rationale: Prescribed exact width, path boundary and periodic wrapping are natural restrictions of interval learning. The all-parameter theorem determines optimal adversarial mistake depth, locates the sharp VC-one/VC-two thresholds and demonstrates an unbounded logarithmic adaptive-static gap even in VC-one path classes. Complementary-width symmetry on cycles has a distinct structural explanation. The complete classification is not merely a finite extrapolation or an arithmetic substitution.
